title: JEE Main 2026 (April 2nd, Shift 2) - Mathematics - Differential Equations
subject: Mathematics

questions.q: Let $x = x(y)$ be the solution of the differential equation $2y^2 \frac{dx}{dy} - 2xy + x^2 = 0, y > 1, x(e) = e$. Then $x(e^2)$ is equal to:
questions.explain:
Rewrite DE: $\frac{dx}{dy} - \frac{x}{y} + \frac{x^2}{2y^2} = 0$. This is a Bernoulli equation.
Divide by $x^2$: $x^{-2} \frac{dx}{dy} - \frac{1}{y}x^{-1} = -\frac{1}{2y^2}$.
Let $v = x^{-1} \implies \frac{dv}{dy} = -x^{-2} \frac{dx}{dy}$. Equation becomes $\frac{dv}{dy} + \frac{1}{y}v = \frac{1}{2y^2}$.
Integrating factor IF $= e^{\int (1/y)dy} = y$.
Solution: $v \cdot y = \int \frac{1}{2y^2} y dy = \frac{1}{2} \ln y + C \implies \frac{y}{x} = \frac{1}{2}\ln y + C$.
Given $x(e) = e \implies \frac{e}{e} = \frac{1}{2}\ln e + C \implies 1 = \frac{1}{2} + C \implies C = \frac{1}{2}$.
So $\frac{y}{x} = \frac{1}{2}\ln y + \frac{1}{2}$.
Substitute $y = e^2$: $\frac{e^2}{x} = \frac{1}{2}\ln(e^2) + \frac{1}{2} = 1 + \frac{1}{2} = \frac{3}{2} \implies x = \frac{2}{3}e^2$.
